gate.how: node --experimental-strip-types, importing gateSense directly; every one of the 60 rows was passed through it

spot_check.note: batch is smaller than 80, so every sense is marked spot_check=true

headword_source.why_not_canonical: TD-17 — newgeneralservicelist.com is not in this environment's egress allowlist. Unchanged from 2026-08-07.
headword_source.caveat: UNVERIFIED MIRROR: 2818 headwords vs NGSL v1.2's documented 2809. Only column 1 was read; the mirror's definitions were discarded unread and no definition was copied.
headword_source.mitigation: all 45 headwords come from ranks 1-45, the most stable region of the list — membership there is identical across every NGSL revision.

selection_rule: ascending NGSL frequency rank, skipping any headword that already has a row in data/generated/. The two earlier batches covered ranks 75-278; ranks 1-75 had never been touched, so this batch takes the 45 most frequent uncovered headwords, which is exactly ranks 1-45.
selection_note: 45 of 45 headwords in this batch are grammar words. That is not a drift in policy — it is the consequence of the ascending rule reaching the top of the list. Every row carries is_function_word so a later feature can decide whether to teach them; ranks 46-75 (the remaining grammar block) are next.
sense_policy: D-021 — one row per sense. 15 of the 45 headwords carry two senses (about, as, at, by, can, for, get, have, know, of, on, so, that, there, with), so 45 headwords produced 60 rows.
provenance: every definition, translation, sentence, stem and distractor in this file was authored for this project. No NITE (R-010), AnkiWeb (R-013) or NC-licensed source was consulted.
open_conflict_carried_over: C-0042 reported it and it is still open: the RLS policy in 0002_content_bank.sql (lines 154-175) filters translation_confidence <> 'low' in all four selects, so the one low-confidence row in this batch (a#1) would never reach a learner — which contradicts D-024. Not mine to fix; flagged for T-042.
